same_time_rules.threshold_snapshot: after all preceding operation completions and before any new starts at this timestamp
same_time_rules.zero_duration_dependency_graph: acyclic; committed finite operations only; no recursive new policy call

WTQ.eligible_available_definition: accepted, ready at current eligible station, unreserved and movable before load; do not truncate this counting set by current residual capacity. Counting does not commit the truck to loading all members.
WTQ.capacity_test: onboard plus active reservations plus new batch <= capacity; active reservation not counted twice
WTQ.clock_origin: unload completion or arrival when unloading skipped

tail.trigger: public future_count == 0 OR declared revelation horizon processed; never use hidden stream exhaustion or predicted mean zero
tail.fallback: retain verified adopted finite feasible plan on timeout/no candidate; never delete accepted obligations
tail.post_selection: execute physical events; suppress discretionary reoptimization and forecast-only reviews
tail.W_zero_only_after_fixed_tail_plan: with exact baseline J and no permitted future changes, residual realized increment is zero; do not label a pre-replanning state zero

probe.meaning: evaluate candidate against cloned current state; inspect accepted/reason; never execute even if feasible

inheritance.external_pipeline: local fixture boundary; a listed completion event supplies that entire pickup once; prior drone operations outside tested scope
inheritance.local_external_recovery: only controller/module tests may use verified boundary contracts; full-day tests and PI witnesses must provide the whole recovery plan

execution_modes.scripted_replay: execute specified actions at given times after event phases; no autonomous route search; unlisted vehicles inactive
execution_modes.controller: run the specified controller only; supplied prior batches immutable; apply common event phases
execution_modes.constraint: evaluate supplied candidates only without changing the real state
execution_modes.candidate: rank the listed candidates; no claim of search completeness
execution_modes.sampling: distribution and support invariants; realized random draws need not equal their expectation
execution_modes.mapping: requires future PI adapter; declarative witness is not proof of implementation correctness

ledger.drone_first_use: first actual ground loading or takeoff, whichever first activates that drone
ledger.rejection: at refusal including final zero-duration decision

assertion_contract.equal: exact scalar/bool/string or ordered-list equality; object key order irrelevant
assertion_contract.close: elementwise absolute error <= 1e-6 for numeric values
assertion_contract.at_null: at test stop or whole-window output as specified by target
assertion_contract.phase: default after complete timestamp closure; before_starts and after_completions are explicit checkpoints
assertion_contract.targets: dot-separated observation names, not paths into the input; adapter must expose the observation registry and reject missing outputs, never silently skip assertions

protocol.evidence_status: All expected values are specifications. Schema checks, static reference checks and arithmetic reviews are not simulator, Gurobi or VFA validation.

action_semantics.truck_dispatch: At depot: assign listed delivery quantities, zero depot handling, charge trip fee once, follow fixed circuit. Pass stations without scheduled work at arrival; at a station with later loading/unloading work remain until explicit continue_circuit or controller departure. No road arc can be interrupted.
action_semantics.truck_continue_circuit: Leave current station after committed work. Traverse remaining fixed arcs and scheduled station work; return event settles onboard pickups. Local input location determines remaining road distance/time.
action_semantics.truck_load: All listed whole pickups must be available at start. Reserve atomically; finish after alpha+beta*sum(q), then transfer in-process to onboard.
action_semantics.truck_unload: At most one positive delivery unloading operation per truck stop; quantities are integer portions of delivery demands, not necessarily whole orders. Goods become available on completion. Reject noninteger quantities without rounding or mutation.
action_semantics.drone_load: Sequential per-request ground loading in listed order; duration delta_i. Commitment begins at start, goods onboard at completion.
action_semantics.drone_sortie: Take off at given time; visit listed customers, deterministic straight flights and one service per request, return home; ground unloading is separate. At coincident addresses the zero flight is closed internally.
action_semantics.drone_unload: Sequential per-request unloading; each pickup becomes available at its individual completion.
action_semantics.customer_service: Duration s_i; delivery completed or pickup collected at end. Does not reset takeoff.
action_semantics.accept/reject: One atomic decision per revealed batch, settle rejection loss before absorption.
action_semantics.probe: Never executes; operation fields describe an attempted action at the current state. Invalid action leaves all actual inventory, commitments and ledger unchanged.
action_semantics.script_vs_controller: Scripted actions are explicit requested operations; a controller validates them and fills only unscripted idle choices, never starts an operation twice. A controller assertion of a unique chosen batch requires either a feasibility-forced choice or a fixed candidate set.
action_semantics.constraint_candidate: Pure predicate check. Candidate schedules are proposed timings, not actual events; no ledger changes.
action_semantics.event_injection: Completion-only local fixtures describe already committed external operations. Full-day replay has no injected inventory; all goods originate from the listed requests and operations.

protocol.fixture_disclosure: All listed D are initially known. P with accepted true is an inherited disclosed commitment; accepted null remains hidden until its listed reveal event or is presented as a newly revealed batch in a candidate fixture. Future scenario samples are stored separately and never exposed as real orders.

numeric_rules.rejection_of_boundary_violations: examples use differences 0.01 well above tolerance
numeric_rules.money_sign: revenue positive; each cost field positive expense; net=revenue-sum(costs)

protocol.scope_of_interpretation: Local and controller fixtures test only listed participants and ledger window; they do not certify a full-day feasible policy. Statements of other recovery as boundary contracts are not accepted as full-day or PI evidence.

quantity_domain.candidate_validation_payload: E33 input.candidates[0].validation_payload is a raw module input to validate; it is not adopted state, inventory or an executed action. Reject before committing any operation. Expected accept is only acceptance of the quantity contract, not whole-route feasibility.
